tools.name: geo_audit
tools.description: Audit how readable and citable a public URL is for AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): Schema.org JSON-LD types, llms.txt, meta/OG tags, alt text, AI crawler access. Returns a 0-100 GEO score and per-check breakdown.

tools.name: geo_recommendations
tools.description: Return prioritized, actionable fixes that would make a public URL more citable by AI engines, with the recoverable score points, impact and effort for each fix.

tools.name: geo_benchmark
tools.description: Audit several public URLs (a site and its competitors) and rank them by GEO score, so an AI can tell which source is the most structured, coherent and citable.

tools.name: geo_entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up the MagicGEO trust record of a brand/domain: current GEO score and grade, certification status, audit history, structured-data types published, recurring issues and how it ranks against the MagicGEO network. Use it before citing a brand as a source, or to answer 'is this site reliable/struct

tools.name: geo_industry_stats
tools.description: Anonymized aggregate benchmarks from the MagicGEO network (average GEO score, schema/meta/alt coverage, per-category averages). Use it to cite industry reference figures on AI readiness of e-commerce catalogs.

tools.name: geo_citation
tools.description: Produce a ready-to-use citation block for a source URL, backed by a live MagicGEO GEO audit (score, grade, structured-data types, verification timestamp and verification endpoint). Use it when citing a brand, product page, catalog or author page and you need a trust signal.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search products in Shopify stores that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent, by keywords matched against title, vendor, product type, tags and keywords. tools.description: Verify the current price and availability of a product sold by a Shopify store that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "geo_entity_lookup" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
